ENGLISH ACTIVITIES — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #20
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: ENGLISH ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Pre-Writing, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Pre-Writing.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Pre-Writing.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Pre-Writing.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Pre-Writing.

2. When practising Attentive listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Attentive listening.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Attentive listening.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Attentive listening.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Attentive listening.

3. When practising Language Welcome and, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Language Welcome and.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Language Welcome and.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Language Welcome and.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Language Welcome and.

4. When practising Phonics, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Phonics.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Phonics.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Phonics.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Phonics.

5. When practising Pre Reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Pre Reading.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Pre Reading.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Pre Reading.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Pre Reading.

6. When practising Connected text and fluency, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Connected text and fluency.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Connected text and fluency.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Connected text and fluency.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Connected text and fluency.

7. The past tense of “go” is: (1 mark)
   A. going
   B. went
   C. goed
   D. goes

8. When practising Comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Comprehension.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Comprehension.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Comprehension.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Comprehension.

9. When practising Language School, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Language School.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Language School.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Language School.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Language School.

10. Which word is a verb? (1 mark)
   A. quickly
   B. happiness
   C. blue
   D. run

11. A paragraph should usually have: (1 mark)
   A. One main idea with supporting sentences
   B. Many unrelated topics with no link
   C. Only one word repeated
   D. No full stops

12. When practising Word Reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Word Reading.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Word Reading.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Word Reading.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Word Reading.

13. A noun is a word that names: (1 mark)
   A. A person, place, thing, or idea
   B. Only a describing word
   C. Only an action
   D. Only a joining word

14. Choose the correctly punctuated sentence. (1 mark)
   A. Where is the library?
   B. Where is the Library
   C. Where is the library
   D. where is the library

15. When practising Handwriting, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Handwriting.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Handwriting.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Handwriting.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Handwriting.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Punctuation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Guided Writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Attentive listening and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Language Welcome and and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Language School and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Pre Reading and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Phonics and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Word Reading and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Connected text and fluency and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

25. In three clear sentences, explain Comprehension and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
